requirements_tools.name: Polarion ALM
requirements_tools.use: Work items, test runs and risk records

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects in the factory: id, name, device, safety standard, world model.

tools.name: get_trace
tools.description: Trace of a safety requirement (e.g. SR-1): hazards it mitigates, regulation clauses, code lines, unit test and result, simulation scenarios, work orders and evidence, plus its coverage gaps.

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: Merge verdict of a work order (e.g. WO-345): status, decision, requirement test results, world-model simulation verdict and the evidence-pack headline.

tools.name: list_gaps
tools.description: Coverage gaps of a project: requirements without code or test links or with failing tests, hazards without a mitigating requirement, and safety code no requirement traces to.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Search the factory's org memory, regulatory knowledge base and lessons from past verdicts (HydraDB, local fallback).
